company.name: Jingle Pay
company.shortDescription: A financial super-app that empowers you with a versatile financial account simplifying all your money.
company.description:
Jingle Pay empowers you with an AED account, free of fees and zero-commitments, to reliably store, spend, and send money to 160+ countries, in 99+ currencies, at the best exchange rates globally.
Jingle Pay offers multi-currency accounts, card payments, International money transfers, peer 2 peer payments (pay, request, splitting bills), and analytics.

productsAndServices.description: A digital bank account with no minimum balance requirement that supports multiple transactions including bill payments, mobile top-ups, and fund transfers.

productsAndServices.description: An account to receive international money transfers directly with cashback rewards on every transfer.
productsAndServices.name: Home Remittance Account

productsAndServices.description: A service to instantly send money to friends using their mobile number or contacts securely and without hassle.

productsAndServices.description: A platform feature to pay utility bills such as electricity, gas, water, and telecom services quickly and set reminders to avoid missed payments.

productsAndServices.description: A debit card linked to the Jingle Pay account that offers cashback on transactions and a joining bonus.

productsAndServices.description: Tools to split bills among friends and request money easily using mobile contacts within the app.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $4,204,094 to $35,421,063, a 8.43x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 35 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 41 (-6).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
